01 / Institutional Background

Boutique Agility. Doctoral & Technological Rigor.

Established in 2019, VFFC was conceived to solve a critical structural disconnect in Vietnam’s fast-moving economy: the gap between international institutional standards and grounded domestic execution.

Our executive board pairs doctoral alumni from France’s premier academic centers—IGR-IAE Rennes University and INSA Rennes University—with leading technology and process engineering talent from the Florida Institute of Technology (USA). This unique union bridges sophisticated European investment analysis, quantitative risk modeling, advanced digital transformation, and hands-on site technical auditing.

We do not delegate senior mandates to junior analysts. Every transaction, hotel management agreement (HMA), bridge calculation, solar farm pro forma, and enterprise digital workflow is personally directed by our principal partners.

01

Integrity & Truth

Unyielding transparency. We provide unbiased feasibility and technical truths, preventing costly capital misallocations.

Academic Precision

Doctoral methodology meets empirical construction metrics, financial engineering, and automated digital systems.

Global Standards

05 / Rigorous Execution

The VFFC Consulting Framework.

Every client engagement follows an institutional, audited 4-stage advisory workflow to ensure financial viability and zero technical surprises.

STAGE 01

Due Diligence & Title Verification

Exhaustive land title verification, planning zoning compliance, environmental constraints, and preliminary investment barrier analysis.

Risk Screening
STAGE 02

Quantitative Pro Forma Modeling

Bank-ready financial feasibility models, scenario sensitivity, debt repayment schedules, and operator yield optimization.

Financial Engineering
STAGE 03

Technical & Process Architecture

Third-party structural engineering reviews, advanced material specifications, digital workflows, and contractor tender vetting.

Engineering Mastery
STAGE 04

Governance & Milestone Handover

Earned-value milestone tracking, inter-ministerial liaison, statutory handover filings, and post-delivery asset performance monitoring.

Executive Close-Out
